cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(artifacts C)
add_library(store STATIC store/store.c)
add_library(net SHARED net/net.c)
add_library(plugin MODULE plugin/plugin.c)
add_executable(tool tool/main.c)
target_link_libraries(tool PRIVATE store net)
target_link_libraries(plugin PRIVATE net)
add_subdirectory(tests)
